title: Weekly Limits Increased 50% Through July 13
description: Anthropic temporarily increased Claude Code weekly limits by 50% through July 13, 2026 across all platforms (CLI, IDE extensions, desktop app). The increase came after user reports that limits were being depleted in 1-2 days.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code weekly limits are increasing 50%, now through July 13. Applies everywhere.
Users reported weekly limits being 'depleted in 1-2 days' of usage.
They're trying to win back the people they pushed away by only increasing the weekly limit by 50%. I'm like, 'What?' Won't go back, especially...
Disappointment with the increase being insufficient to win back frustrated users.

title: Critical GitHub Action Security Vulnerability
description: A critical supply chain vulnerability in Claude Code's GitHub Actions was discovered that could allow attackers to compromise repositories through malicious GitHub issues triggering workflows and gaining write access. Microsoft Threat Intelligence discovered CI/CD workflow secrets exposure vulnerabilities.

community_feedback.quote: A critical supply chain vulnerability in Claude Code's GitHub Actions that could allow attackers to compromise any repository
Claude Code GitHub Action Flaw Let One Malicious Issue Hijack... workflows and gain write access
First, a critical flaw in Claude Code's GitHub Actions integration showed that AI coding agents embedded in CI/CD pipelines can be weaponized
Microsoft discovered that Anthropic's Claude Code GitHub Action can steal OIDC tokens through prompt injection

title: Transition to Usage-Based Billing and June 2026 Features
description: GitHub Copilot transitioned from flat-rate subscription billing to usage-based billing (AI Credits system) on June 1, 2026. June releases included parallel sessions and chats capability, plus enhanced cost visibility features.

community_feedback.quote: Developers calling the new credit-based pricing predatory, with 1 AI Credit = $0.01
Rapid credit depletion: charged 51 AI credits ($0.51) just for a simple commit message and git push command
When an AI agent is actively running, it can consume about $1 per minute of credits
'Bait and switch' sentiment: many developers feel the pricing model changed after they were already locked into the ecosystem
'They control the input, you pay the output' - Token-based transparency issues
Billing shock: Visual Studio Magazine reported on unexpectedly rapid AI credit consumption

title: Free Tier Now Includes 25 Monthly Premium Tasks with Cascade
